coordinate_system: Blender world, meters, +X character left, -Y forward, +Z up
method: Manual anatomical landmarks from orthographic textured Blender views and numerical mesh slices; internal joint centers are estimates, not recovered author rig
finger_order: thumb/index/middle are joints _0,_1,_2 then tip; ring/little are metacarpal _0, MCP _1,PIP _2,DIP _3 then tip. Mirror X for right hand; source approximately symmetric.
caution: Native glTF Blender bone tails point along imported local axes and do NOT reliably identify anatomical endpoints. Use next child bone HEAD for segment endpoint. Keep native rest matrices and bone hierarchy. Native ring/little _0 are palm metacarpals, not finger MCPs.
